infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: QuestHat uses the camera so you can record short quest videos and add profile or quest photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: QuestHat uses the microphone to include sound in videos you record for a quest.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: QuestHat uses your photo library so you can attach media to quests.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: QuestHat uses your calendar only when you choose to add a hosted or joined quest, including its time and location.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: QuestHat uses calendar access to add joined quests and keep their date and time up to date.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: QuestHat adds joined quests to your calendar when you ask.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: QuestHat uses your location to show nearby quests, estimate distance, and verify check-ins. Your precise location is not shown to hosts or attendees unless you explicitly choose to share it in a feature that clearly asks first.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: QuestHat uses motion data to support device and media interactions in the app.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow QuestHat to add joined quests and keep their schedule up to date in your calendar.
